Every join passes with producer keys the reader cannot authenticate: union and tuple rows carry keys of a producer 'forger' that name no document of this package, and are admitted and returned byte for byte. Admission is not a claim of provenance.

Mix carries one case of every payload form: native Boolean and Integer, the object type Holder (reference of its effective id), a union Link, a tuple Pair, the declared unit ms (quantity of the declared unit key) and the record Wrapper, authored in the reverse of canonical order so rank and position differ; Nada is nullary. Closure edges: Mix 7, Wrapper 2, Link 1, Node 1, Holder 3, Shape 2, Pair 2. Witnesses: model_tuples for Pair, declarations for Holder (object_type), Node and Wrapper (record_value_type) and ms (declared_unit), and the union rows Link, Mix, Shape.
Wrapper reaches Shape and Boolean (2); Shape adds 2 and Pair adds 2. Only Shape and Pair need rows.
Node reaches Link and Link's More reaches Node, which is not expanded again. Link's payload original type is the composite of the Node record's declaration witness.
Orphan, Wrapper, Node, Holder, Mix, Link and ms are not reached from Shape and have no declaration witness; they are neither required nor inspected.

Fixture B under full scope: every union-family node (Link, List, Mix, Shape; the enum-family Color needs none) and every tuple node (Cell, Nest, Pair, Swap) has a row, and every payload's declaration witness is given. Orphan is no payload and needs no declaration.
The Swap tuple row names the wrong original identity and is not reached, so it is neither inspected nor charged; the same rows under full scope refuse (MUW-TR-09).

note: QSL-2743. Row-contract vectors for FR-830 (selected model-union and model-tuple witness rows). INPUTS. Each case names a fixture pair of `fixtures` (A or B): a complete FCD selected document (`document`) and a complete checked package (`package`); a positive's `document_patch` is a JSON Patch over that document's real members (`/types/N/variants/...`), never over a projection. Fixture B is an additive completion of A: domain-package-acme-shapes-witness.json adds the record construct, the dimension Time, the unit ms, the records Wrapper, Node and Orphan and the unions Link and Mix to domain-package-acme-shapes.json, and fixtures/witness-model-union-rows.json adds the matching model nodes (object_type Holder, three record_value_type, two variant_type, the dimension and the unit node, each a model-owned node with the empty aggregate body, one generated occurrence and no declaration, as in the existing model-owned timed fixtures), each with its source_map entry and its empty operand_rows entry, before the model_root. The sidecar of a case is the object `{model_tuples, model_unions}` and its `witnesses.declarations` rows; these are the whole input beside the package, the document and the lock, so no tuple, record, object or unit witness is held in memory by the producer: every join runs from bytes. A refusal's `patch` is a JSON Patch over the sidecar object (pointers `/model_tuples/...` and `/model_unions/...`), its `witnesses_patch` one over `witnesses` (pointers `/declarations/...`), `scope_override` replaces the base's scope, and it inherits the base's fixtures, document_patch, scope, witnesses, model_tuples and model_unions. `file_members` names identity-file members present and unchanged that no check reads. ENCODINGS are the producer sidecar's existing ones written as JSON values: `structural_node` and each payload `node` are the serde form of CheckedNodeId, which is the `node_id` object of the node in the package; `type_handle`, `settled_key`, `node_key`, `member.declaration` and the composite and unit `node` of `original_type` are OriginalNodeKey values (nested at most 32 keys); `original_type` is a complete OriginalValueType (a reference carries `effective: {chain: [{package, node}]}`); `original_case` is the DeclarationKey {package, node} of the selected document's variant. The vectors are symbolic: node ids are written as the node ids of the packages and no vector derives an original key from a name. Declarations rows are written `{structural_node, selected_document, form, original_identity, exact_identity}` with `exact_identity` `{kind: record|object|declared_unit, value}`. Row order, scope and budget follow FR-830: the sidecar rows sort ascending by structural_node, a union's cases by UTF-8 byte order of name, and equal neighbouring structural_nodes are a duplicate (a conflict), not a disorder. The first refusal wins: each mutation is chosen so that no earlier check refuses first. A positive inherits nothing; a refusal inherits its base and a budget case builds its base with an ample budget. Budgets are baseline-relative (W, S, Wt, St are measured on the same input by the same budget), never static totals. STATUS: no harness executes these vectors and nothing is qualified by them. The packages and documents are inputs, not results of any reader.
